_about: Public-domain Warren Akin Candler (1857-1941), president of Emory College and bishop of the Methodist Episcopal Church, South, for the Word Hoard: The History of Sunday-schools, Not Less Education, Christus Auctor (a manual of Christian evidences), Great Revivals and the Great Republic, Dangerous Donations and Degrading Doles, Wesley and his Work, and Our Mission in Cuba. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 100 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
